adjudication.rationale: The diff changes COLLECTIVE team bookings to include multiple destination calendars (handleNewBooking.ts: pushes team members’ destinationCalendar into evt.destinationCalendar) and then creates calendar events for each destination (EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents now loops over event.destinationCalendar and calls createEvent per destination). For Google Calendar, createEvent always does a separate calendar.events.insert with conferenceDataVersion: 1 (GoogleCalendarService.createEvent), so a Google Meet-style conference attached to the calendar event would be created per-host event rather than shared. The booking/reference logic appears to surface only one meetingUrl/externalCalendarId (EventManager maps results into a single reference per result, and downstream consumers typically use the booking-stored link), so additional host events can end up with different conferencing data than what attendees use.
